test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The marked price of an item is ₹ 5,800. If Ravi earns a profit of 25% after allowing a discount of 20%, then the cost price of the item is:
solution:
Given:

Marked Price = Rs. 5800

Discount = 20%

Profit = 25%

Concept used:

Selling Price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Selling Price = Cost Price (1 + Profit/100)

Calculation:

Selling Price = 5800 - 5800 × 20% = Rs. 4640

Cost Price = 4640 ÷ (1 + 25/100) = Rs. 3712

**∴ The cost price of the item is Rs. 3712.**
